name: crowdsec-cyber-threat-intelligence
label: CrowdSec Cyber Threat Intelligence
description: CrowdSec Cyber Threat Intelligence & Service APIs provide a unified, real-time threat intelligence and automation platform that enables organizations to detect, enrich, and respond to cyber threats at scale.

fields.title: CTI Base URL
fields.name: cti_base_url
fields.description: Specify the base endpoint for the CrowdSec Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) API. All CTI requests (IP reputation, enrichment, behaviors) are sent to this URL.
fields.tooltip: Default CTI endpoint is https://cti.api.crowdsec.net/v2. Change only if CrowdSec provides a different endpoint.

fields.title: CTI API Key
fields.name: cti_api_key
fields.description: Specify the API key used to authenticate requests to the CrowdSec CTI API. This key identifies your organization and grants access to threat intelligence data.
fields.tooltip: Generate this key from the CrowdSec Console. Required for CTI queries and smoke tests.

fields.title: Service API Base URL
fields.name: service_api_base_url
fields.description: Specify the base endpoint for the CrowdSec Service (Admin) API. Used for managing services such as blocklists, decisions, or organization-level operations.
fields.tooltip: Only required if you plan to use Service API features (e.g., blocklist or decision management).

fields.title: Service API Key
fields.name: service_api_key
fields.description: Specify the API key used to authenticate requests to the CrowdSec Service (Admin) API. Grants permission to manage resources such as blocklists and decisions.
fields.tooltip: Obtain this key from the CrowdSec Console. Needed only for Service API operations, not for CTI lookups.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set as True.
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set as True.

operations.title: Get IP Reputation
operations.description: Retrieve detailed threat intelligence, reputation scoring, and behavioral context for a given IP address using the CrowdSec CTI API.

parameters.title: IP Address
parameters.description: Specify the IPv4 or IPv6 address to investigate for malicious activity, reputation, and threat context.
parameters.name: ip_address
parameters.tooltip: Specify a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address (e.g., 8.8.8.8 or 2001:4860:4860::8888).

operations.title: Search IP Reputation
operations.description: Search CrowdSec Cyber Threat Intelligence for IP addresses matching a Lucene query, with optional time filtering and pagination.

parameters.title: Query
parameters.description: Lucene query used to filter IPs based on CrowdSec CTI fields such as behaviors, classifications, ASN, or location.
parameters.name: query
parameters.tooltip: Use Lucene syntax (e.g., behaviors.label:"SSH Bruteforce").

parameters.title: Since
parameters.description: Restrict results to IPs observed within a given time window.
parameters.name: since
parameters.tooltip: Time window format: 1m, 15m, 1h, 24h, 7d. If omitted, no time filtering is applied.

parameters.title: Page
parameters.description: Page number used for paginated results.
parameters.name: page
parameters.tooltip: Default is page 1. Use this to navigate through large result sets.

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of IP results returned per page.
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Default is 10. Maximum is 10 for Community CTI users; higher limits may be available for paid plans.

operations.title: Batch Get IP Reputation
operations.description: Retrieve threat intelligence and reputation data for multiple IP addresses in a single request using the CrowdSec CTI API.

parameters.title: IP Addresses
parameters.description: Specify the list of IPv4 and/or IPv6 addresses to query in bulk.
parameters.name: ips
parameters.tooltip: Specify the IPs separated by commas or new lines. Example: 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8. Ensure the number of IPs does not exceed CTI batch limits.

operations.title: Get Fire IPs
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of malevolent IP addresses from the CrowdSec CTI API, with optional filtering based on last modification time.

parameters.title: Page
parameters.description: Page number used to paginate through the list of malevolent IPs.
parameters.name: page
parameters.tooltip: Default is 1. Use this parameter to navigate between result pages.

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of malevolent IP records returned per page.
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Default is 50. Maximum allowed value is 1000 per request.

parameters.title: Since
parameters.description: Filter results to include only IPs updated within a specified time window.
parameters.name: since
parameters.tooltip: Specify a duration such as 15m, 6h, or 3d to return IPs modified within that period.

operations.title: List All Blocklists
operations.description: Retrieve all blocklists configured in the CrowdSec Service (Admin) API for the authenticated organization.

operations.title: Create New Blocklist
operations.description: Create a new custom blocklist in the CrowdSec Service (Admin) API for organizing and enforcing threat containment policies.

parameters.title: Blocklist Name
parameters.description: Unique name used to identify the blocklist within the CrowdSec organization.
parameters.name: name
parameters.tooltip: Unique name used to identify the blocklist within the CrowdSec organization.

parameters.title: Description
parameters.description: Optional explanation of the blocklist’s purpose and usage.
parameters.name: description
parameters.tooltip: Optional explanation of the blocklist’s purpose and usage.

operations.title: Update Blocklist
operations.description: Update the metadata and CTI-driven configuration of an existing blocklist in the CrowdSec Service (Admin) API.

parameters.title: Blocklist ID
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the blocklist that will be updated.
parameters.name: blocklist_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the blocklist ID as returned by the List or Create Blocklist operations.

parameters.title: Label
parameters.description: Display label shown for the blocklist in the CrowdSec console and APIs.
parameters.name: label
parameters.tooltip: Use a short, human-readable label describing the blocklist purpose.

parameters.title: Description
parameters.description: Detailed explanation of the blocklist’s intent, scope, and usage.
parameters.name: description
parameters.tooltip: Updated description for the blocklist

parameters.title: References
parameters.description: Supporting references associated with the blocklist.
parameters.name: references
parameters.tooltip: Supporting references associated with the blocklist. Reference URLs (one per line)

parameters.title: Tags
parameters.description: Tags used to classify and organize the blocklist.
parameters.name: tags
parameters.tooltip: Tags for the blocklist (comma-separated)

parameters.title: CTI Query
parameters.description: Lucene query used to select IPs from CrowdSec CTI when populating the blocklist.
parameters.name: from_cti_query
parameters.tooltip: Use valid Lucene syntax (e.g., country:RU)

parameters.title: Since Period
parameters.description: Relative time window applied to the CTI query to filter IPs by recency.
parameters.name: since
parameters.tooltip: Specify a duration such as 15m, 24h, 7d, or 1m. Only IPs updated within this period are included.

operations.title: Add IPs to Blocklist
operations.description: Add one or more IP addresses to a specific blocklist in the CrowdSec Service API. If an IP already exists in the blocklist, its expiration date will be updated.

parameters.title: Blocklist ID
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the blocklist to which IPs will be added.
parameters.name: blocklist_id
parameters.tooltip: Provide the blocklist ID as returned from the List or Create Blocklist operations.

parameters.title: IP Addresses
parameters.description: IP addresses to add to the blocklist.
parameters.name: ips
parameters.tooltip: Enter IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, either comma-separated or one per line. Example: 192.168.1.100, 10.0.0.5

parameters.title: Expiration Date
parameters.description: Date and time when the IP entry should expire and be automatically removed from the blocklist.
parameters.name: expiration
parameters.tooltip: Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Example: 2026-01-31T23:59:59Z

operations.title: Get Blocklist IPs
operations.description: Retrieve all IP addresses currently listed in a specific blocklist from the CrowdSec Service API.

parameters.title: Blocklist ID
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the blocklist from which to fetch IP addresses.
parameters.name: blocklist_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the blocklist ID as returned by List or Create Blocklist operations.

operations.title: Delete IPs from Blocklist
operations.description: Remove one or more IP addresses from a specific blocklist in the CrowdSec Service API.

parameters.title: Blocklist ID
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the blocklist from which the IPs will be removed.
parameters.name: blocklist_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the blocklist ID as returned from List or Create Blocklist operations.

parameters.title: IP Addresses
parameters.description: IP addresses to be removed from the blocklist.
parameters.name: ips
parameters.tooltip: Provide IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, either comma-separated or one per line. Example: 192.168.1.100, 10.0.0.5

operations.title: Bulk Overwrite Blocklist IPs
operations.description: Replace all existing IP addresses in a specific blocklist with a new set of IPs. Existing entries will be fully overwritten.

parameters.title: Blocklist ID
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the blocklist to be overwritten.
parameters.name: blocklist_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the blocklist ID as returned by List or Create Blocklist operations.

parameters.title: IP Addresses
parameters.description: New IP addresses that will replace all existing entries in the blocklist.
parameters.name: ips
parameters.tooltip: Provide IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, either comma-separated or one per line. Example: 192.168.1.100, 10.0.0.5

parameters.title: Expiration Date
parameters.description: Date and time when the new IP entries should expire and be automatically removed from the blocklist.
parameters.name: expiration
parameters.tooltip: Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Example: 2026-01-31T23:59:59Z

operations.title: Get Specific Blocklist
operations.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific blocklist in the CrowdSec Service API by its ID.

parameters.title: Blocklist ID
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the blocklist to retrieve.
parameters.name: blocklist_id
parameters.tooltip: Enter the blocklist ID as returned by the List or Create Blocklist operations.

operations.title: Delete Blocklist
operations.description: Permanently delete a specific blocklist in the CrowdSec Service API by its ID. All IPs and metadata in the blocklist will be removed.

parameters.title: Blocklist ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique identifier of the blocklist to be deleted.
parameters.name: blocklist_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the blocklist ID as returned by List or Create Blocklist operations.

operations.title: List All Allowlists
operations.description: Retrieve a list of all allowlists configured in the CrowdSec Service API.

operations.title: Create New Allowlist
operations.description: Create a new custom allowlist in the CrowdSec Service API to define IPs that should be explicitly allowed or excluded from automatic blocking.

parameters.title: Allowlist Name
parameters.description: Specify the unique name to identify this allowlist.
parameters.name: name
parameters.tooltip: Specify a descriptive, unique name for the allowlist.

parameters.title: Description
parameters.description: Optional description explaining the purpose of this allowlist.
parameters.name: description
parameters.tooltip: Provide details about the allowlist purpose or intended usage.

operations.title: Get Items in Allowlist
operations.description: Retrieve all IP addresses or entries contained in a specific allowlist from the CrowdSec Service API.

parameters.title: Allowlist ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique identifier of the allowlist whose items you want to retrieve.
parameters.name: allowlist_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the allowlist ID as returned by List or Create Allowlist operations.

operations.title: Add IPs to Allowlist
operations.description: Add one or more IP addresses to a specific allowlist in the CrowdSec Service API.

parameters.title: Allowlist ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique identifier of the allowlist to which IPs will be added.
parameters.name: allowlist_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the allowlist ID as returned by List or Create Allowlist operations.

parameters.title: IP Addresses
parameters.description: Specify the IP addresses to add to the allowlist.
parameters.name: items
parameters.tooltip: Specify IPs (comma-separated or one per line). Example: 192.168.1.100, 10.0.0.5

parameters.title: Description
parameters.description: Optional description for the added IPs.
parameters.name: description
parameters.tooltip: Provide a short description explaining the purpose of these allowlist entries.

parameters.title: Expiration Date
parameters.description: Optional expiration date for these allowlist items.
parameters.name: expiration
parameters.tooltip: Set when these items should expire (ISO format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Leave blank for permanent entries.

operations.title: Get Specific Allowlist Item
operations.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific allowlist item by its ID from the CrowdSec Service API.

parameters.title: Allowlist ID
parameters.description: Specify the Unique identifier of the allowlist containing the item.
parameters.name: allowlist_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the allowlist to which the item belongs.

parameters.title: Item ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the allowlist item you want to fetch.
parameters.name: item_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the allowlist item you want to fetch.

operations.title: Update Allowlist
operations.description: Modify the name or description of an existing allowlist in the CrowdSec Service API.

parameters.title: Allowlist ID
parameters.description: Specif the Unique identifier of the allowlist to update.
parameters.name: allowlist_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the allowlist ID you want to modify.

parameters.title: Name
parameters.description: Specify the new name for the allowlist.
parameters.name: name
parameters.tooltip: Provide a new name for the allowlist. Leave empty to keep the current name.

parameters.title: Description
parameters.description: Specify the new description for the allowlist
parameters.name: description
parameters.tooltip: Provide a new description for the allowlist. Leave empty to keep the current description.

operations.title: Delete Item from Allowlist
operations.description: Remove a specific item from an existing allowlist in the CrowdSec Service API.

parameters.title: Allowlist ID
parameters.description: Specify the Unique identifier of the allowlist containing the item to delete.
parameters.name: allowlist_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the allowlist from which you want to remove an item.

parameters.title: Item ID
parameters.description: Specify the Unique identifier of the item to remove from the allowlist.
parameters.name: item_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the specific allowlist item you want to delete.

operations.title: Delete Allowlist
operations.description: Permanently delete a specific allowlist in the CrowdSec Service API by its ID.

parameters.title: Allowlist ID
parameters.description: Specify the Unique identifier of the allowlist you want to delete.
parameters.name: allowlist_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the allowlist to remove.

parameters.title: Force Delete
parameters.description: Whether to force deletion even if the allowlist has subscribers.
parameters.name: force
parameters.tooltip: Set to true to force delete an allowlist that has active subscribers.

operations.title: List Integrations
operations.description: Retrieve a list of all integrations available in the CrowdSec Service API.

operations.title: Create Integration
operations.description: Create a new integration with a firewall or remediation system, managed by your organization.

parameters.title: Name
parameters.description: Specify a unique name for this integration within your organization.
parameters.name: name
parameters.tooltip: Specify a unique name for this integration within your organization.

parameters.title: Description
parameters.description: Provide a description explaining the purpose of this integration.
parameters.name: description
parameters.tooltip: Provide a description explaining the purpose of this integration.

parameters.title: Entity Type
parameters.description: Specify the type of integration (default: firewall_integration)
parameters.name: entity_type
parameters.tooltip: Specify the type of integration (default: firewall_integration)

parameters.title: Output Format
parameters.description: Choose the output format for the integration (default: plain_text)
parameters.name: output_format
parameters.tooltip: Choose the output format for the integration (default: plain_text)

operations.title: Get Integration
operations.description: Retrieve the details of a specific integration by its ID, including associated blocklists and configuration.

parameters.title: Integration ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique ID of the integration you want to retrieve
parameters.name: integration_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique ID of the integration you want to retrieve.

operations.title: Update Integration
operations.description: Update the details of an existing integration, including name, description, output format, and credentials.

parameters.title: Integration ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique ID of the integration you want to update
parameters.name: integration_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique ID of the integration you want to update

parameters.title: Name
parameters.description: New name for the integration
parameters.name: name
parameters.tooltip: New name for the integration.

parameters.title: Description
parameters.description: New description for the integration
parameters.name: description
parameters.tooltip: New description for the integration

parameters.title: Output Format
parameters.description: Updated output format for the integration (e.g., plain_text)
parameters.name: output_format
parameters.tooltip: Updated output format for the integration (e.g., plain_text)

parameters.title: Regenerate Credentials
parameters.description: Set to 'true' to regenerate API credentials for this integration.
parameters.name: regenerate_credentials
parameters.tooltip: Set to 'true' to regenerate API credentials for this integration.

operations.title: Delete Integration
operations.description: Permanently delete an existing integration by its unique ID from the CrowdSec Service API.

parameters.title: Integration ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique ID of the integration you want to delete
parameters.name: integration_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique ID of the integration you want to delete
